scenicChapters.title: Lavaux Vineyard Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 32 km this is Lavaux Vineyard Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Thun and Lauterbrunnen Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 59 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-montreux-inter.story: A 225 km one-way ride from near Montreux, about 3 h 39 of riding. The stops in between: Lausanne, Neuchatel and Bern. The highest point is about 2,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
